# Nostrapps UI kit

`ui.ts` and `ui.css` are unmodified from eskema/nostrapps commit
`08a7f6f3335da56d86acc715567812ca11b7c873`, licensed under the accompanying
Unlicense. They execute only in an embedded application's document. The adapter
is `../ui.ts`; generated CSS adds the upstream icon-mask projections. Fonts use
the kit's system-font fallbacks without remote font requests.
